andrea-vitali.title: Dr
andrea-vitali.role: Clinical Director · Implantology and Oral Surgery
andrea-vitali.short: Clinical lead since 2007. Focused on complex rehabilitations and guided implant surgery.
andrea-vitali.bio: A graduate in Dentistry from the University of Milan, he specialised in oral surgery and implantology, training in both Italy and Sweden. Since 2007 he has led the practice as clinical director, working in particular on complex implant-supported rehabilitations and guided surgery. He introduced the fully digital workflow, from diagnosis through to the final restoration.
education: Degree in Dentistry — University of Milan
Specialisation in Oral Surgery — University of Turin
Continuing education in implantology — Gothenburg, Sweden
andrea-vitali.member: Active member of SIO — Italian Society of Osseointegrated Implantology
andrea-vitali.quote: An implant is not a procedure: it is the beginning of a twenty-year relationship.

chiara-bonetti.title: Dr
chiara-bonetti.short: Invisible orthodontics, aligners and interceptive treatment in children.
chiara-bonetti.bio: A specialist in orthodontics, she treats both adults and growing patients. She works mainly with clear aligners and discreet techniques, integrating gnathological assessment into the planning of every case. She lectures on digital orthodontics.
education: Degree in Dentistry — University of Bologna
Specialisation in Orthodontics — University of Ferrara
Advanced certification in aligner therapy
chiara-bonetti.member: Member of SIDO — Italian Society of Orthodontics
chiara-bonetti.quote: Moving a tooth is simple. Knowing where it should end up, much less so.

marco-ferretti.title: Dr
marco-ferretti.short: Works under the operating microscope on retreatment and adhesive restorations.
marco-ferretti.bio: His clinical work is devoted entirely to endodontics and restorative dentistry, always under high-magnification microscopy. He focuses in particular on retreating complex cases, fractured teeth, and adhesive restorations that avoid the need for a crown.
education: Degree in Dentistry — University of Pavia
Master's in Clinical and Microscopic Endodontics
Postgraduate training in adhesive dentistry
marco-ferretti.member: Member of SIE — Italian Society of Endodontics
marco-ferretti.quote: A natural tooth, even a compromised one, is almost always worth more than any substitute.

sofia-ranieri.title: Dr
sofia-ranieri.short: Designs the smile with Digital Smile Design, from veneers to full aesthetic rehabilitation.
sofia-ranieri.bio: She works in cosmetic dentistry and fixed prosthodontics, with particular attention to minimal-thickness ceramics. She uses Digital Smile Design to plan the result on the patient's face before any preparation, and works closely with the in-house dental laboratory.
education: Degree in Dentistry — Vita-Salute San Raffaele University
Master's in Cosmetic Dentistry and Adhesive Prosthodontics
Training in clinical dental photography
sofia-ranieri.member: Member of SIDOC — Italian Society of Restorative Dentistry
sofia-ranieri.quote: A successful smile is one nobody notices.

elena-moretti.title: Dr
elena-moretti.short: Leads the prevention programme and non-surgical periodontal therapy.
elena-moretti.bio: A specialist in periodontology, she leads the practice's hygiene and prevention department. She follows patients with periodontitis from initial therapy through to maintenance, and designs the personalised recall intervals that keep results stable over time.
education: Degree in Dentistry — University of Milan-Bicocca
Master's in Clinical Periodontology
elena-moretti.member: Member of SIdP — Italian Society of Periodontology and Implantology
elena-moretti.quote: Periodontitis does not hurt until it is too late. That is why we check.

luca-sartori.title: Dr
luca-sartori.short: Third molar surgery, regenerative procedures and care of anxious patients.
luca-sartori.bio: He works in outpatient oral surgery, complex extractions, regenerative surgery and sinus lifts. He is the reference point for conscious sedation, which makes treatment possible for patients with severe anxiety or a strong gag reflex.
education: Degree in Dentistry — University of Padua
Specialisation in Oral Surgery
luca-sartori.quote: Half the work is technique. The other half is making someone feel safe.

giulia-pace.title: Dr
giulia-pace.short: First visits, prevention and interceptive orthodontics for children and teenagers.
giulia-pace.bio: Her work is dedicated to growing patients, from the first visit at around four years old through to adolescence. She focuses on desensitisation, prevention and the early interception of growth problems, with short appointments and language designed for children.
education: Degree in Dentistry — University of Florence
Master's in Paediatric Dentistry
giulia-pace.member: Member of SIOI — Italian Society of Paediatric Dentistry
giulia-pace.quote: A child who is not afraid of the dentist becomes an adult who gets their teeth checked.

marta-colombo.title: Dr
marta-colombo.short: Fixed and removable prosthodontics, full rehabilitation and digital workflows.
marta-colombo.bio: She works in fixed and removable prosthodontics and full rehabilitation on natural teeth and implants. She manages the practice's digital workflow, from intraoral scanning to CAD design, in collaboration with the in-house laboratory.
education: Degree in Dentistry — University of Genoa
Master's in Digital Dental Prosthodontics
marta-colombo.member: Member of AIOP — Italian Academy of Prosthetic Dentistry
marta-colombo.quote: A well-made restoration is not noticed: it is forgotten.

silvia-ferrari.short: Manages the diary, estimates, insurance paperwork and patient welcome.
silvia-ferrari.bio: She is the first person you meet when you walk in, and the point of reference for everything around treatment: appointments, estimates, payment plans, insurance and health fund paperwork, and coordination between departments.
silvia-ferrari.quote: Treatment begins long before the chair.
